episodes.name: The Bots and the Bees
episodes.overview: Bender fathers a child with the office soda machine.

episodes.name: A Farewell to Arms
episodes.overview: An ancient prophecy predicts the world will end in the year 3012.

episodes.name: Decision 3012
episodes.overview: Leela becomes campaign manager for a presidential candidate whose birth certificate is mysteriously missing.

episodes.name: The Thief of Baghead
episodes.overview: Bender joins the paparazzi and attempts to photograph a famous actor whose face has never been seen.

episodes.name: Zapp Dingbat
episodes.overview: Zapp Brannigan loses interest in Leela and instead turns his attentions towards her mother, Turanga Munda.

episodes.name: The Butterjunk Effect
episodes.overview: Leela and Amy become addicted to the performance enhancing drug known as "Nectar" to increase their chances of winning at the epic sport of Butterfly Derby.

episodes.name: The Six Million Dollar Mon
episodes.overview: Hermes replaces parts of his body with robotic counterparts so as to increase his productivity.

episodes.name: Fun on a Bun
episodes.overview: Fry is the victim of a sausage-making accident during the crew's visit to Oktoberfest.

episodes.name: Free Will Hunting
episodes.overview: Bender searches for the meaning of life after learning that robots lack free will.

episodes.name: Near-Death Wish
episodes.overview: The Professor is deeply disturbed when his parents return from virtual retirement aboard the Near-Death Star.

episodes.name: Viva Mars Vegas
episodes.overview: The crew stages a casino heist to recover stolen property from the Robot Mafia.

episodes.name: 31st Century Fox
episodes.overview: After saving a robotic fox from hunters, Bender becomes the hunted.

episodes.name: Naturama
episodes.overview: Bender and the crew are reimagined as wild animals in a nature documentary.

episodes.name: 2-D Blacktop
episodes.overview: Professor Farnsworth joins a gang of street-racing punks.

episodes.name: Fry and Leela's Big Fling
episodes.overview: Fry and Leela's romantic vacation goes disturbingly wrong.

episodes.name: T.: The Terrestrial
episodes.overview: After being marooned on a distant planet, Fry is befriended by a young monster.

episodes.name: Forty Percent Leadbelly
episodes.overview: At a maximum security prison, Bender meets a famous folk singer and attempts to make a copy of his precious guitar.

episodes.name: The Inhuman Torch
episodes.overview: Bender becomes a famous firefighter, but the crew suspects him of arson.

episodes.name: Saturday Morning Fun Pit
episodes.overview: The Futurama gang stars in a trio of craptastic morning cartoons.

episodes.name: Calculon 2.0
episodes.overview: Bender goes grave robbing to bring his favorite actor back to life.

episodes.name: Assie Come Home
episodes.overview: Bender searches the universe for his missing shiny metal rear end.

episodes.name: Leela and the Genestalk
episodes.overview: After a rare condition causes Leela to grow tentacles, she stumbles upon a secret genetic engineering facility.

episodes.name: Game of Tones
episodes.overview: The crew journeys into Fry's dreams to seek the meaning of a mysterious alien melody.

episodes.name: Murder on the Planet Express
episodes.overview: The crew becomes trapped aboard a ship with a horrific alien creature.

episodes.name: Stench and Stenchibility
episodes.overview: Dr. Zoidberg meets the love of his life while Bender squares off in a deadly tap dancing competition.

episodes.name: Meanwhile
episodes.overview: Fry asks Leela to marry him, and they face their destiny together as the Professor's latest invention alters the fabric of time.
